timestamp.description: The timestamp for when the block was collated

sha3_uncles.description: SHA3 of the uncles data in the block

logs_bloom.description: The bloom filter for the logs of the block

transactions_root.description: The root of the transaction trie of the block

state_root.description: The root of the final state trie of the block

receipts_root.description: The root of the receipts trie of the block

miner.description: The address of the beneficiary to whom the mining rewards were given

difficulty.description: Integer of the difficulty for this block

total_difficulty.description: Integer of the total difficulty of the chain until this block

size.description: The size of this block in bytes

extra_data.description: The extra data field of this block

gas_limit.description: The maximum gas allowed in this block

gas_used.description: The total used gas by all transactions in this block

transaction_count.description: The number of transactions in the block

base_fee_per_gas.description: Protocol base fee per gas, which can move up or down

withdrawals_root.description: The root of the withdrawal trie of the block

blob_gas_used.description: The total amount of blob gas consumed by transactions in the block

excess_blob_gas.description: A running total of blob gas consumed in excess of the target, prior to the block. This is used to set blob gas pricing

nonce.description: The number of transactions made by the sender prior to this one

transaction_index.description: Integer of the transactions index position in the block

to_address.description: Address of the receiver. null when its a contract creation transaction

gas_price.description: Gas price provided by the sender in Wei

input.description: The data sent along with the transaction

receipt_cumulative_gas_used.description: The total amount of gas used when this transaction was executed in the block

receipt_gas_used.description: The amount of gas used by this specific transaction alone

receipt_contract_address.description: The contract address created, if the transaction was a contract creation, otherwise null

block_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the block where this transaction was in

block_number.description: Block number where this transaction was in

block_hash.description: Hash of the block where this transaction was in

max_fee_per_gas.description: Total fee that covers both base and priority fees

max_priority_fee_per_gas.description: Fee given to miners to incentivize them to include the transaction

receipt_effective_gas_price.description: The actual value per gas deducted from the senders account. Replacement of gas_price after EIP-1559

max_fee_per_blob_gas.description: The maximum fee a user is willing to pay per blob gas

blob_versioned_hashes.description: A list of hashed outputs from kzg_to_versioned_hash

value.description: Amount of tokens transferred (ERC20) / id of the token transferred (ERC721). Use safe_cast for casting to NUMERIC or FLOAT64

log_index.description: Log index in the transaction receipt

block_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the block where this transfer was in

block_number.description: Block number where this transfer was in

block_hash.description: Hash of the block where this transfer was in

is_erc20.description: Whether this contract is an ERC20 contract

is_erc721.description: Whether this contract is an ERC721 contract

block_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the block where this contract was created

block_number.description: Block number where this contract was created

block_hash.description: Hash of the block where this contract was created

symbol.description: The symbol the contract reported when last probed

name.description: The name the contract reported when last probed

decimals.description: Decimals as reported, as a string. Use safe_cast for casting to NUMERIC or FLOAT64

decimals_int.description: Decimals as an integer where the reported value is a sane decimal, else NULL

total_supply.description: The freshest known total supply: the latest reading when it is at least as recent as the metadata probe, else the probe's own value. NULL by design for pure ERC-1155 contracts

total_supply_bignumeric.description: The same supply as BIGNUMERIC where it fits, for arithmetic without casting

total_supply_block_number.description: The block total_supply was read at - the freshness handle the compat shape cannot carry

total_supply_block_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the block total_supply was read at

metadata_block_number.description: Block the metadata (symbol/name/decimals/standards) was probed at

metadata_block_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the metadata probe block

metadata_block_hash.description: Hash of the metadata probe block, the EIP-1898 reference the probe pinned

token_standard.description: The most specific standard the contract satisfies: ERC1155, ERC721 or ERC20

token_standards.description: Every standard the contract satisfies, from bytecode evidence unioned with ERC-165 answers

protocols.description: Protocol tags, lowercase - the extension point for standards beyond the launch set

is_erc20.description: The deployed bytecode satisfies the ERC-20 selector predicate

is_erc721.description: The deployed bytecode satisfies the ERC-721 selector predicate

is_erc1155.description: The deployed bytecode satisfies the ERC-1155 selector predicate

supports_erc721_interface.description: The contract answered the ERC-165 ERC-721 interface id

supports_erc1155_interface.description: The contract answered the ERC-165 ERC-1155 interface id

has_code_at_metadata_block.description: The address had runtime code at the metadata probe block

implementation_address.description: For proxies, the implementation the contract delegates to

proxy_standard.description: How implementation_address was determined: eip1167 or eip1967

admitted_by.description: Provenance of THIS probe row: what admitted the address on an admission row, or what triggered the re-probe on an upgrade/redeployment/sweep row (creation_bytecode, first_transfer_log, protocol_event, reconciliation_sweep). Read with probe_reason, which says which of the two it is

probe_reason.description: Why this probe ran: admission, upgrade, redeployment, sweep or protocol_added

creator_address.description: The address that deployed the contract

creation_transaction_hash.description: Hash of the transaction that deployed the contract

block_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the block where this token was created

block_number.description: Block number where this token was created

block_hash.description: Hash of the block where this token was created

symbol.description: Amended symbol: the hand-written amendment when one exists, else the probed value.

name.description: Amended name: the hand-written amendment when one exists, else the probed value.

decimals.description: Amended decimals: the hand-written amendment when one exists, else the probed value.
